services.name: 3 Hour Ice Fishing Trip
services.desc: 3 hours Before booking We practice CATCH & RELEASE for all trips. Under no exceptions do we keep fish to bring home Trip Description Escape the crowds and step onto a frozen Whistler lake and immerse yourself in one of Canada’s most iconic winter traditions with Whistler Year-Round Fishing. We’ll outfit you with warm, insulated winter boots complete with ice cleats for safety and comfort, then take you to one of our prime local lakes. There, your expert guide sets up a spacious, heated ice-fishing shelter that keeps you toasty warm while you target feisty stocked rainbow trout Winter · Can accommodate groups up to 10 people
